CustomField.description: Procurement's own Approve/Reject/Deferred decision on this uploaded document, distinct from the AI's Status__c verdict and from the Analyst's Analyst_Validated__c sign-off — a separate, earlier checkpoint that never overrides either. Deferred means Procurement can't make the call and the document needs a specialist's read once the case reaches an Analyst — see Procurement_Decision_Reason__c for the note, which is Analyst-only, never shown to the supplier. Set via VendorPortalController.recordProcurementDecision.
CustomField.label: Procurement Decision
